narrative:
FY2026 revenue is forecast at GBP 663.9M against a GBP 668.6M budget (−GBP 4.7M, −0.7%), still +2.8% on FY2025 actuals of GBP 645.8M. The FY2027 budget is GBP 680.5M. About 88% of revenue is recurring rental and subscription.

Gamma Business (UK channel partners) is the largest segment at GBP 310.0M but shrinks −2.5%: legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases are running 31% above plan ahead of the January 2027 switch-off, and only 64% of lost lines migrate to PhoneLine+ or Horizon. Gamma Germany grows +19% to GBP 152.3M after the acquisitions.

Revenue is planned as units × ARPU + CDR usage × rate + one-off. The ML forecast proposes units, ARPU and usage per product; planners accept or override, and every change is audited.

signals.title: FY2025 results: revenue £645.8m, adjusted EBITDA £141.7m
signals.excerpt: Gross profit £348.2m (54%), recurring revenue £572.0m. Germany gross profit +197% to £78.4m; Gamma Business GP −2%; Enterprise GP flat.

signals.title: UK PSTN switch-off — January 2027
signals.excerpt: Exchanges moving to stop-sell accelerate legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases; customers must migrate to IP voice (PhoneLine+, Horizon, SIP) or leave.

signals.title: FP&A runs on Excel and months-old data
signals.excerpt: Forecast and variance analysis are built in Excel from MySQL and SQL Server extracts; reporting data was as old as 18 August, with manual reprocessing in FP&A and reporting.
